    SELECT
        order_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_discount_amount
    FROM order_discounts
    GROUP BY order_id

order_level_shipments AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        SUM(shipping_fee) AS total_shipping_fees
    FROM order_shipments

),

        SUM(o.base_amount) AS total_gross_sales,

    LEFT JOIN order_level_discounts d

    LEFT JOIN order_level_shipments s

    COALESCE(mo.total_shipping_fees, 0.00) AS total_shipping_fees
FROM merchants m
LEFT JOIN merchant_orders mo

tasks.name: Clickstream Sessionization with Inactivity Gaps
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH event_lags AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id
                ORDER BY event_timestamp, event_id
            ) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
            OR LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id
                ORDER BY event_timestamp, event_id
            ) IS NULL
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session
    FROM user_events
),
session_groups AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id
            ORDER BY event_timestamp
        ) AS session_id
    FROM event_lags
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_groups
GROUP BY
    user_id,
    session_id
ORDER BY
    user_id ASC,
    session_start ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE 
                 OR LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session
    FROM user_events
),
session_indexed AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CAST(SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS BIGINT) AS session_id
    FROM lagged
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_indexed
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;
